description: Buying a House '26: Home Improvement Retailers backdrop — housing turnover (existing home sales) + mortgage rates + NAICS 444 retail sales + housing starts/permits + lumber PPI + SE drought (ticker-scoped TSCO/LESL). Forums in home_improvement_forums. Tickers HD, LOW, FND, TSCO, LESL.

series.label: Existing Home Sales (SAAR)
series.official_name: FRED EXHOSLUSM495S — Existing Home Sales (NAR), seasonally adjusted annual rate
series.notes: Hero turnover series — low sales suppress discretionary renovation. Live FRED EXHOSLUSM495S is a rolling ~13-month NAR license window; deeper history spliced from config/seeds/existing_home_sales_archive.csv (provisional NAR reconstruction — murky redistribute; FRED wins on overlap). Prefer licensing NAR historical file for production.

series.label: New One Family Houses Sold (SAAR)
series.official_name: FRED HSN1F — New One Family Houses Sold (Census), seasonally adjusted annual rate
series.notes: Longer-history housing-activity complement to existing-home turnover (new construction / Pro adjacency).

series.label: 30-Year Fixed Rate Mortgage Average
series.official_name: FRED MORTGAGE30US — 30-Year Fixed Rate Mortgage Average in the United States (Freddie Mac)
series.notes: Affordability / lock-in driver. Rising rates → lower turnover (score polarity −1).

series.label: Retail Sales: Building Material and Garden Equipment and Supplies Dealers (NAICS 444)
series.official_name: FRED MRTSSM444USS — Retail Sales: Building Material and Garden Equipment and Supplies Dealers, SA
series.display_name: US building materials & garden retail sales (NAICS 444)
series.notes: Direct home-improvement retail demand proxy (HD/LOW peer set).

series.label: Housing Starts: Total New Privately Owned Housing Units Started
series.official_name: FRED HOUST — New Privately-Owned Housing Units Started (Census), SAAR

series.label: New Privately-Owned Housing Units Authorized in Permit-Issuing Places
series.official_name: FRED PERMIT — New Private Housing Units Authorized by Building Permits (Census), SAAR
series.notes: Forward construction pipeline; softer than starts for remodelers.

series.label: PPI Commodity: Lumber and wood products
series.official_name: FRED WPU081 — Producer Price Index by Commodity: Lumber and Wood Products (BLS)
series.display_name: US lumber & wood products producer prices
series.notes: Building-materials COGS proxy. Rising lumber PPI → margin/pricing headwind (score polarity −1).

series.label: S&P/Case-Shiller U.S. National Home Price Index (SA)
series.official_name: FRED CSUSHPISA — S&P/Case-Shiller U.S. National Home Price Index, seasonally adjusted
series.notes: Housing-cost level (home prices). Complements mortgage rate + forum cost-talk; lumber PPI stays materials COGS.

series.label: Monthly Supply of New Houses
series.official_name: FRED MSACSR — Monthly Supply of New Houses in the United States (Census)
series.display_name: US months' supply of new homes
series.notes: Inventory overhang proxy — higher supply → softer housing activity (score polarity −1 if used).

series.label: Southeast drought area in D1 or worse (%)
series.official_name: USDM traditional D1+ area % — unweighted mean of AL/FL/GA/LA/MS/NC/SC/TN (FIPS)
series.notes: Seasonal outdoor/lawn/pool demand proxy for TSCO/LESL. Not in theme backdrop score.
